basic_info.description: Welcome to 254 Edgewood Ave, located on one of San Francisco's most famous and coveted streets. This 5-bedroom, 3-bath home still has its original details and is waiting for a new owner to add their personal touches. The home has incredible natural light, unobstructed views of downtown SF, multiple outdoor spaces, hardwood floors throughout and there's additional square footage to be added within the footprint of the home.
